data.name: Catalina 270 - Coronado Bareboat Rental
data.headline: 8 hour options
data.description: These sailboats provide the ultimate sailing experience in an eight-person vessel.
data.what_is_included: Amenities include steering wheel helm, inboard diesel, generous beam, extended cockpit seating, two burner propane stove, cooler box, VHF, enclosed head and private aft cabin. Perfect for a day on the bay or an overnight excursion.
data.what_is_not_included: After hours and overnight rentals add on a 10% turnover fee to the final cost.
what_is_not_included_items: After hours and overnight rentals add on a 10% turnover fee to the final cost.
data.what_to_bring: Photo ID for all drivers and credit card used for payment required for check in.
data.cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
data.cancellation_notes: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund. Once you are within 72 hours, no changes or cancellations are permitted. Failure to show for reservation still incurs full rental rate and is not eligible for a refund or reschedule. As the renter, you are responsible for checking the weather forecast and making any desired changes at least 72 hours in advance.
data.booking_notes:
##What to bring
Photo ID for all drivers and credit card used for payment required for check in.

##Sailing Resume
If you have not rented with Seaforth before, please be sure to complete the following sailing resume as soon as possible, no later than 72 hours prior to your reservation. Resumes not received 3 days prior to the reservation date are subject to cancellation. [Seaforth Sailing Resume](https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/bd2zthntebaxcxvlrqdeqd/web/)
data.disclaimers: Equivalent sailing experience required. A sailing resume will need to be completed at least 48 hours prior to rental for new customers.
